description: Check website measurement, understand booking interest and sales, and choose content using Savri analytics and connected search reports.

interface.longDescription: Understand one or several authorized websites using traffic, goals and connected Google and Bing reports. Review affiliate commission with its matching quality and coverage, or preview alerts when requested. Sources keep their dates, currencies and limitations. Each user connects their own account.
defaultPrompt: How do people find my website, which contact goals are recorded, and what should I improve first?
Compare my selected websites over 30 completed days, with available Google, Bing and Savri data.
Which pages have affiliate clicks and approved commission, and where is evidence missing?
